# Zero-Cost Iterator Pipelines - Combinators (Pattern #1)
Category: Rust Systems Programming
Core Principle: Zero-Cost Iterator Pipelines
Specialization: Combinators (Iteration #1, Tier 1)

## Implementation Strategy
Rust iterators are monomorphized and compiled into flat, vectorized assembly with zero heap allocation and loop unrolling equivalent to hand-written C.

text:
n and loop unrolling equivalent to hand-written C.

## Production-Grade Code
```
pub fn process_data<'a>(input: &'a [u8]) -> impl Iterator<Item = u16> + 'a {
    input.chunks_exact(2)
        .map(|chunk| u16::from_le_bytes([chunk[0], chunk[1]]))
        .filter(|&val| val != 0)
}

from typing import AsyncGenerator
import asyncio

async def token_stream(prompt: str, max_tokens: int = 100) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
    queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=32)
    for i in range(max_tokens):
